enchantment.merlins_inferno.druids_touch: Pickaxe: more Redstone/Lapis. Axe: unlocks Rowanwood's raw material. Sword: more XP/gold, more loot from magical mobs. Rare - usually only found via enchanting at level 30, or as loot.

effect.merlins_inferno.sanctified.descri: The touch of Lyrium. Deals damage over time (it CAN kill you outside Hardcore), grants bonus damage against the Undead, and spreads to whatever you strike in melee. Its level climbs the longer Raw Lyrium stays in your hand.

patchouli.merlins_inferno.category.getti: The basics - what to look for, and where to begin.
$(bold)Merlin's Inferno: Requiem$()

This grimoire will grow as you uncover more of what this land hides - three material lineages (Rowanwood, Demonblood, Seraphium), the Lyrium refinement chain, the Hell Forge, and the Druid's trade, among other things.

More pages are on the way.
